request.cmd:
/usr/bin/python3 -I -B - <<'PY'
import os,stat,pathlib,hashlib,json
W=pathlib.Path('/home/postedism/Desktop/Warden')
N=W/'.cache/task14-fix1-red-20261025-a'
D=W/'docs/evidence/task-14/fix1-red-first-20261025'
assert os.getuid()==1000 and not os.path.lexists(D)
D.mkdir(mode=0o755)
items=[(N/n,n,True) for n in ['stdout.raw','stderr.raw','status.json','request.json']]
items += [(W/n,pathlib.Path(n).name+'.txt',False) for n in ['respond/executor.go','respond/ledger.go','respond/ledger_test.go']]
items += [(W/'.superpowers/sdd/2-warden-security-plan/task-14-fix1-red-freeze.json','freeze.json',False)]
record=[]
for p,name,show in items:
 fd=os.open(p,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
 try:
  s=os.fstat(fd)
  assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==1000 and s.st_nlink==1 and s.st_size<=65536
  raw=os.read(fd,65537)
  a=os.fstat(fd)
  assert len(raw)==s.st_size and (s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns)==(a.st_dev,a.st_ino,a.st_size,a.st_mtime_ns,a.st_ctime_ns)
 finally:os.close(fd)
 out=os.open(D/name,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o644)
 with os.fdopen(out,'wb') as f:f.write(raw)
 record.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(W)),'copy':str((D/name).relative_to(W)),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()})
 if show:print(name+'\n'+raw.decode())
print(json.dumps(record,sort_keys=True))
PY
